title: Gnarly textured mesh metadata
description: Metadata for one zone's textured ARKit scene reconstruction mesh. The mesh itself is the sibling GLB file named by `mesh`. This provides a real-geometry visual layer baked from captured keyframes, complementing RoomPlan's idealized box-based navigation geometry.

coordinateSystem.description: Mesh vertices and textures are in the same ARKit world frame as scan-features.json and building.json.

mesh.description: GLB file name, normally textured-mesh.glb. Contains the ARKit scene reconstruction mesh with texture(s) baked from captured keyframes.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the mesh and keyframes were captured.

keyframeCount.description: Number of keyframe images used to texture the mesh.

meshTriangleCount.description: Number of triangles in the scene reconstruction mesh.

textureFormat.description: Texture compression format used in the GLB. KTX2/Basis preferred for web/Unity compatibility and smaller size.

textureResolution.description: Maximum texture dimension in pixels (for the largest texture if multiple).

texturingMethod.description: Algorithm used to select views and blend textures: mvs-texturing (Waechter MRF), OpenMVS TextureMesh, or manual/other.

usedDepthOcclusion.description: True when LiDAR depth was used during texturing to handle occlusions.
